acceptance_signals: Revalidate the retained consumer repository, Python environment, exact wheel digest, predecessor task hashes, clean remote-free state, user Codex configuration digest, and absence of task-owned processes before launch.
Use the retained offline-installed AgentGov 0.3.0rc1 runtime and packaged eight-tool binding without reinstalling, downloading, or changing Starter or consumer product source.
Create exactly one fresh task-owned disposable Codex home without reading, copying, or changing the real user Codex home.
Perform deterministic read-only Codex executable and App Server protocol preflight before the single launch; stop before launch if required commands or request shapes are not established.
Launch exactly one Codex App Server foreground process from the retained disposable consumer repository using only one-run AgentGov MCP configuration and the retained runtime.
Send only initialize, initialized, one ephemeral thread/start, and at most one MCP status inventory request; never send turn/start, a prompt, or a model payload.

Claim pass only if the ephemeral thread starts and Codex reports the required AgentGov MCP initialized with observable evidence of expected form-capable tool availability; otherwise record the first bounded deviation and stop without repair, restart, substitution, or retry.
Close the exact process input and allow only bounded termination of the positively attributed task process if it cannot exit; confirm no task-owned Codex, AgentGov, or Python process remains.

Preserve the disposable repository clean with zero remotes and zero product or configuration files; preserve user configuration, Starter source and tests, HEAD, remotes, release identity, retained wheel, and predecessor task records.
Record only normalized privacy-bounded evidence and update only the admitted task, evidence, dated log, current status, MCP guide, and product requirement.
Run all declared validation commands and perform a distinct bounded current-Agent review without claiming native self-review completion.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-6e555bf047be43b7811e6a9769162f59 and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: Using the exact retained remote-free disposable consumer repository and its offline-installed AgentGov 0.3.0rc1 runtime, perform one controlled no-model Codex App Server launch with a fresh task-owned disposable Codex home and one-run AgentGov MCP configuration. Complete only the App Server initialize handshake, one ephemeral thread/start, and at most one MCP status inventory request. Pass only if Codex reports the required AgentGov MCP initialized and exposes evidence of the expected form-capable tool availability; otherwise stop at the first deviation without repair, restart, substitution, or retry. Do not send turn/start, create a model turn, invoke an AgentGov tool, modify the consumer repository or user Codex configuration, or perform Git, publication, release, deployment, or cleanup actions.

items: The prior App Server path failed at thread/start; this task must stop at the first repeated or new deviation and must not retry.
A malformed controller could misclassify a protocol failure; request cardinality, response identity, and exit conditions must be deterministic.
Codex could mutate user configuration or the consumer repository; pre/post digests and clean-state checks must detect any change without repairing it.
A foreground App Server or child AgentGov process could remain running; termination is allowed only for a positively attributed task process.
Raw protocol, configuration, paths, process identities, credentials, or model-private data could leak into evidence; retain only normalized bounded outcomes.
The dirty Starter worktree contains earlier user and task changes that must remain classified, excluded where applicable, and preserved.
Possible background network behavior cannot be treated as absent unless directly established.
Reviewed assumption: The retained disposable consumer repository and offline-installed Python 3.11 environment remain readable and unchanged.
Reviewed assumption: A compatible Codex CLI with App Server support is locally available.
Reviewed assumption: A no-model App Server initialization and ephemeral thread can run without copying credentials into the disposable Codex home.
Reviewed assumption: One-run MCP configuration can bind the retained AgentGov runtime without project trust or user-configuration mutation.
Reviewed assumption: The fully specified low-risk successor implements the product owner's selected initialization-only direction and requires no new architecture choice.
Reviewed unknown: Whether the current Codex App Server accepts the established initialize, ephemeral thread, and MCP status request shapes on this host.
Reviewed unknown: Whether Adapter 1.7.0 resolves the required-MCP thread-start failure observed by earlier Adapter versions.
Reviewed unknown: Whether Codex exposes sufficient MCP status or tool-inventory evidence before any model turn to prove expected form-capable tool availability.
Reviewed unknown: Whether the Codex process performs any background network activity despite the absence of a model request.
Reviewed unknown: Whether a successful single host result generalizes to other consumers, Codex versions, hosts, or operating systems.

title: Disposable Codex MCP initialization v1
